verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party Lovable MCP server through which an external AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code and deploy apps. That is an official server mode, so the story applies and is delivered. Separately, it can turn published apps into MCP servers for ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants. Missing for 10: setup, auth and tool-list details for the Lovable MCP server beyond a single summary line, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: your AI agent can create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, deploy apps, and more, all without leaving the client you're already working in
Turn a published Lovable app into an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants. Configure tools, sign-in, permissions, and access.
